units.source_text: 名人夫人和大竹夫人的面容干裂而苍白。

en.t: The faces of the Master's wife and Otake's wife were dry, cracked, and pale.

units.source_text: 对局一开始，名人夫人照例离开房间。

en.t: As soon as the match began, the Master's wife left the room as usual.

units.source_text: 可是，今天她马上又折回来，在隔壁的房间继续注视着名人。

en.t: But today she immediately came back and continued watching the Master from the adjoining room.

units.source_text: 小野田六段闭上眼睛，把头垂下来。

en.t: Onoda, sixth dan, closed his eyes and lowered his head.

units.source_text: 观战的村松梢风露出一副目不忍睹的样子。

en.t: Muramatsu Shofu, who was watching the match, wore an expression as if he could hardly bear to look.

units.source_text: 连大竹七段也一声不吭，不敢正视自己的对手—名人。

en.t: Even Otake, seventh dan, said nothing and did not dare look directly at his opponent, the Master.
